scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:server && npm run install:electron
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n SERVER,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.open:routes: sh -c 'sleep 2; open http://localhost:5173/main; open http://localhost:5173/station; open http://localhost:5173/admin'
scripts.dev:all:open: sh -c 'npm run open:routes & npm run dev:all'
